review.assessment: This change introduces three unrelated module stubs (`catalog/cart.py`, `catalog/inventory.py`, `catalog/search.py`) and modifies no existing data ingestion, parsing, or lookup logic required to resolve legacy "OLD-" prefixed SKUs. Consequently, the OLD-8842 issue remains unaddressed, and reconciliation numbers will not be corrected by this diff alone.

findings.actual: Diff contains only new files with placeholder cart/inventory/search functions; zero lines modify existing readers or SKU normalization paths.
findings.defect: No legacy SKU prefix normalization implemented.
findings.expected: Code that strips or maps the "OLD-" prefix during SKU resolution in one of the four readers, ensuring OLD-8842 resolves to its catalog equivalent.
